name: ColumnName
label: Column Name
description: The name of the new column.

name: DataType
label: Data Type
description: The data type of the new column (e.g., string, int, DateTime).

name: InsertLocation
label: Insert Location
description: Specifies whether to insert the column at the end or before a specific column index.

selectOptions.label: Before Column Index
selectOptions.description: Inserts the column before the specified index.

selectOptions.label: End of Data Table
selectOptions.description: Appends the column at the end of the data table.

name: ColumnIndex
label: Column Index
description: Zero-based index where the column should be inserted (used only when location is 'Before Column Index').

name: ModifiedDataTable
label: Modified Data Table
description: The updated data table with the new column inserted.
